text:
Nina V (Eng): quick question — planning 10 weeks parental leave for a domestic adoption in Oct. Couple of weird ones: 1) does leave pause my equity vesting schedule? 2) can Redwood's dependent childcare subsidy be applied retroactively if I start it after leave starts?
Omar J (People Ops): congrats! short answers: 1) leave doesn't pause standard vesting schedule automatically. we offer an option to extend your vesting window by the leave length for eligible long leaves — that requires a written election before leave starts. ping me and we'll add it to your form. 2) childcare subsidy can be started during leave but not paid retroactively; you can enroll and it will apply from the next payroll cycle after enrollment.
Leah M (Finance): equity addendum — we can do a vesting extension addendum (LOE) for leaves >= 8 weeks. steps: employee signs LOE, manager confirms leave dates, Finance records in equity ledger. Code note: put "LEAVE-EXT" on the equity note so grants don't auto-expire incorrectly.
Nina V (Eng): good to know. if i elect LOE, does it affect option exercise window on termination?
Leah M (Finance): LOE extends vesting only, not post-termination exercise windows. exercise window rules unchanged unless you negotiate a separate exception with comp. we can loop Legal if you need a contract change.
Nina V (Eng): cool. about the subsidy — i missed the open-enrollment cutoff this month. can i enroll mid-cycle?
Omar J (People Ops): you can enroll outside OE for qualifying life events like adoption. submit the Adoption Enrollment form in benefits portal and upload placement docs. Benefits will enable subsidy on next payroll cycle. subsidy is capped at $600/month and requires receipts.
payroll-bot: Enrollment checklist -> https://intranet.redwood/hr/benefits/adoption-enroll
```
1) Employee files Adoption Enrollment
2) Upload placement docs
3) People Ops confirms
4) Payroll adds SUBSIDY code starting next cycle
```
payroll-bot: subsidy is processed as a reimbursement (non-taxable) if receipts show childcare expense. if you prefer advance stipends, that's taxable and handled via the Emergency Stipend form.
Benefits Team: to clarify 1 adoption is a qualifying life event; subsidy will be active once docs verified. receipts must show childcare provider name, dates, and amount. we can back-date subsidy only if the placement falls within the same calendar month and you filed within 30 days — otherwise no retro pay.
Nina V (Eng): thanks all. Omar, i'll file the parental leave + LOE request today and upload docs. Leah, can you flag Comp so they know LOE is incoming?
Leah M (Finance): flagged Comp. thanks.
Omar J (People Ops): got it. Nina, DM me the final dates and i'll start the LOE paperwork. congrats again! :tada:
